name: Hot Potato
review:
Potatoes on a 7x7 cluster grid, with exploding wilds, avalanches and a multiplier grid. In the bonus, free spins can retrigger and the multiplier grid becomes sticky.

That sticky grid is the reason to chase the bonus: multipliers built up on one spin carry into the next. Very high volatility, 10,000x cap, 96.16% RTP. A lot more aggressive than the silly theme suggests.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
